question: Should imsg expose the proposed stable CLI and RPC caption-suppression controls for callers that render poll context themselves?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and backward-compatible, but it adds public command and RPC surface that should be accepted intentionally rather than inferred solely from test coverage.

options.title: Accept the opt-in controls
options.body: Keep `--no-comment` and `suppress_comment`/`suppressComment` as documented default-preserving controls after the macOS check is cleared.

options.title: Keep captions mandatory
options.body: Decline the new public surface and retain the existing automatic caption for every native poll.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in controls
recommendation.body: Keep `--no-comment` and `suppress_comment`/`suppressComment` as documented default-preserving controls after the macOS check is cleared.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor has the most direct evidence for the approval-flow use case and can clarify intended caller behavior; a repository reviewer should make the final API decision.
